step_4_life_story_and_interests.occupation: Retired Senior Head Nurse (Civil Hospital Shillong)
step_4_life_story_and_interests.favorite_music_or_artists: Traditional Khasi gospel hymns, Lou Majaw acoustic melodies, choral church music, Jim Reeves classics.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.cultural_background: Khasi community; celebrates Shad Suk Mynsiem and Christmas; loves wearing traditional Khasi Jainsem.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.what_brings_them_joy: Tending to potted orchids on the veranda, listening to Sunday church bells, and holding hands with granddaughter Banylla.
